issue_context.title: client-go fake: UpdateStatus mutates spec
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

Calling UpdateStatus with fake client-go mutates spec

### What did you expect to happen?

UpdateStatus only mutates status, like with real client

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

```
package gateway

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/fake"
)

func TestUpdateStatus(t *testing.T) {
	f := fake.NewSimpleClientset()
	f.CoreV1().Pods("default").Create(
		context.Background(),
		&corev1.Pod{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "test-pod"},
			Spec:       corev1.PodSpec{NodeName: "test-node"},
		},
		metav1.CreateOptions{},
	)
	pod, _ := f.CoreV1().Pods("default").Get(context.Background(), "test-pod", metav1.GetOptions{})
	t.Log(pod.Spec.NodeName)
	f.CoreV1().Pods("default").UpdateStatus(
		context.Background(),
		&corev1.Pod{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "test-pod"},
		},
		metav1.UpdateOptions{},
	)
	pod, _ = f.CoreV1().Pods("default").Get(context.Background(), "test-pod", metav1.GetOptions{})
	t.Log(pod.Spec.NodeName)
}
```

Result:
```
=== RUN   TestUpdateStatus
    kube_fake_test.go:23: test-node
    kube_fake_test.go:32: 
--- PASS: TestUpdateStatus (0.00s)
```

review_comments: Unfortunately, not all resources uniformly prevent writes to everything outside `Status` via the status subresource. Several resources allow modifying metadata (labels, annotations, finalizers, etc)

You're right. I checked most resources status updating logic, all of them are not allowed to update spec, and some of them have some more fields preserved. I'm still working on an uniform way to implement/call these resources specific behaviors into fake client, otherwise this will be a large update to implement all server-side behaviors.
